resumeText:
Sneha Kulkarni | Pune | sneha.kulkarni@example.com

SUMMARY
Clinical data professional with 4 years in a CRO on oncology and vaccine trials.

EXPERIENCE
Clinical Data Coordinator II, Sahyadri Clinical Research Services, Pune (2022 - present)
- Run day-to-day data management for two Phase III oncology studies in Medidata Rave EDC.
- Wrote edit check specifications and tested 300 edit checks during study build UAT.
- Raised and closed data queries with 40 sites through discrepancy management in Rave.
- Coded adverse events and concomitant medications using MedDRA and WHODrug dictionaries.
- Completed SAE reconciliation with the safety team before database lock for one study.

Clinical Data Associate, Sahyadri Clinical Research Services, Pune (2021 - 2022)
- Reviewed data listings and followed ICH-GCP guidelines for a Phase II vaccine trial.
- Built weekly query ageing reports in Excel for the project data manager.

EDUCATION
M.Pharm Pharmacology, Poona College of Pharmacy, 2021

SKILLS
Medidata Rave, CRF design, MedDRA, WHODrug, Excel, ICH-GCP
